from_notes: 17th BRICS Summit 2025 – Date: 6–7 July 2025. Venue: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Host country: Brazil.
x: The 17th BRICS Summit (Rio de Janeiro, 6–7 July 2025) was hosted by Brazil, so it was chaired by Brazil's President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Ramaphosa (South Africa) chaired the 15th (Johannesburg, 2023); Egypt's El-Sisi and Indonesia's Prabowo lead newer members, not the 2025 host.
source: Rocket CA 2026 Part 01 p.220 (17th Summit: Rio, host Brazil); Rocket CA 2026 Part 01 p.75 (Lula da Silva, President of Brazil); PMF International Relations p.113 (Rio Summit hosted by Brazil)

from_notes: The 6th BIMSTEC Summit was held on April 4, 2025, in Bangkok, Thailand ... under the theme “BIMSTEC: Prosperous, Resilient and Open”.
x: The 6th BIMSTEC Summit (Bangkok, 4 April 2025, Thailand in the chair) adopted the Bangkok Vision 2030 under the theme "BIMSTEC: Prosperous, Resilient and Open". The other options are invented themes.
source: Daily EM CA 1 Nov 2026 p.1; Civic Centre APPSC daily 2 Nov 2026 p.2; PMF International Relations p.118 (Bangkok Vision 2030 for a prosperous, resilient & open Bay of Bengal)

from_notes: Indus Waters Treaty – Signed: 19 September 1960; Countries: India and Pakistan; Mediator: World Bank
x: The Indus Waters Treaty was signed on 19 September 1960 in Karachi by Nehru and Ayub Khan, with the World Bank as mediator: eastern rivers (Ravi, Beas, Sutlej) to India, western rivers (Indus, Jhelum, Chenab) to Pakistan. India put it in abeyance after the Pahalgam attack (April 2025).

from_notes: The UNFCCC is the parent climate treaty, adopted at the 1992 Rio Earth Summit
x: The first Earth Summit (UN Conference on Environment and Development, June 1992) was held at Rio de Janeiro; it adopted the UNFCCC, CBD and Agenda 21. Paris hosted COP21 (2015), not the Earth Summit.

from_notes: 1267 Sanctions Committee: Designates global terrorists and imposes asset freeze, travel ban, and arms embargo; e.g., Masood Azhar is listed under this regime.
x: Masood Azhar was listed (May 2019) by the UNSC 1267 (ISIL/Da'esh and Al-Qaida) Sanctions Committee, which imposes asset freeze, travel ban and arms embargo; China had blocked the listing for years. The 1540 Committee deals with WMD non-proliferation and the 1373 Counter-Terrorism Committee with general state obligations.
source: PMF International Relations p.152; Rocket CA 2026 Part 01 p.188 (UNSC Resolution 1267 sanctions in the BRICS Delhi Declaration)
